name: Damara
title: Damara: The Bloodstone Lands
description: A rugged mountain kingdom famous for its iron and bloodstone mines.
wiki: Damara was once a unified kingdom that fell into ruin after the war with the Witch-King of Vaasa. It is now a collection of semi-independent baronies working to rebuild their former glory.

popup.title: Heliogabalus
popup.description: The capital city and primary trade hub of Damara.
